mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may decrease mefloquine levels; both drugs lower seizure threshold and can cause CNS/neuropsychiatric adverse effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor mefloquine efficacy closely and watch for increased neuropsychiatric or seizure-related symptoms; consider alternative antimalarial or anticonvulsant.
